title: Turkish Eggs with Chilli Butter
intro: Thick garlic yoghurt, perfectly poached eggs and the most delicious chilli butter. Ten minutes, one plate, absolutely no regrets.

items: 200 g Skyr or thick Greek yogurt
Pita, toast or kulcha, to scoop

method: Mix the yogurt, garlic, coriander and salt, and spread it across the plate.
Bring water to a gentle simmer, add the vinegar, give it a swirl and drop an egg into the middle. Cook 3 minutes for a soft yolk. Repeat with the second egg.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and sit them on the yogurt.
Foam the butter in a small pan, add the chilli flakes and chilli powder for 20 seconds, then take it off the heat.
Spoon the chilli butter over the eggs and yogurt. Top with coriander, break the yolk and scoop.
tips: Cold eggs straight from the fridge poach neater than room-temperature ones.
Crack each egg into a small sieve first. The watery white drains off and you get a tight, round egg.
The yogurt should be thick enough to hold a spoon upright. If it's loose, hang it in a muslin for 30 minutes.
